email.body1:
Matt, saw CGTech rolled VERICUT 9.6 with the new Assistant and Intelligence AI layers, plus the AI optimisation push at MACH 2026.

When the product story shifts that fast, the manufacturers worth reaching usually outnumber what the territory can cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for CGTech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your CNC number
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for CGTech.

A bigger AI-led catalog means more named accounts per rep, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the territory number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CGTech needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for CGTech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CGTech's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a technical-sales motion like CGTech's? I will tailor it either way.
